title: 第17章 空间迷雾精神崩溃第18章 猛鬼大厦灵性联系
slug: 虚实梦境之主从死后开始
content_zh:
终于见到了几个正常人，可把李笑笑给激动坏了。
然而，当她仔细看清面前几人的时候，却宛如被一盆冰水当头浇下，整个人瞬间僵住。
因为，眼前这些人，竟然全都一模一样。
九…九胞胎?！
虽然知道不可能，但李笑笑还是胡乱的找着借口安慰自己。
再然后…
“轰隆隆…”
听着突然传来的声音，李笑笑本能的快速转头。
一辆疾驰的压路机，正向着他们疯狂驶来。
“啊~，躲、快躲开！”
李笑笑一声尖叫，竭力地向着旁边扑去，同时还不忘本能的提醒众人。
一丝波动自其身上闪过，力量陡的几何倍数增长，速度瞬间加快，于关键之时躲过了迎面而来的压路机。
“轰隆隆…”
“噗噗噗…”
勉强躲过的李笑笑，只觉得一片温热液体瞬间淋了一身。
“啊~！”
看着身上的一片殷红，力量重新恢复正常的李笑笑，再一次的尖叫，恨不得立即昏死过去。
只可惜，她除了贡献一大波能量之外，丝毫没有昏过去的迹象。
当其手脚酥软，连滚带爬的跑到路边之后，不禁大吐特吐起来。
当她慢慢的回过神来，抬头看向道路中间的时候，却惊愕的发现，那里哪有半个人影？更没有任何的一点血迹。

李笑笑低头，身上已被鲜血浸染。
“这、这是怎么回事？”
李笑笑茫然的抬头。
然后…
她便在道路的对面，看到了一群等红灯的人群。
并且，她还看到一些人在向她招手。
那不是先前碰到的九人又是谁？
不由得，李笑笑打了个冷颤，一股股的恐惧自心中升起，让她情不自禁的双臂抱胸，似乎这样就能获得一点温暖与安全。
跑…
此时的李笑笑心中，就只有这一个念头。
瞬间，李笑笑转身就跑。
“踏踏踏…”
content_en:
Finally meeting a few normal people made Li Xiaoxiao extremely excited.
However, when she took a closer look at the people in front of her, she felt as if a basin of ice water had been poured over her head, and her whole body froze instantly.
Because, these people in front of me are all exactly the same.
Nine... ninets?!
Although he knew it was impossible, Li Xiaoxiao still randomly found excuses to comfort himself.
And then…
"Rumble..."
Listening to the sudden sound, Li Xiaoxiao instinctively turned his head quickly.
A speeding steamroller was driving towards them crazily.
"Ah~, hide, hide quickly!"
Li Xiaoxiao screamed and threw himself to the side with all his strength. At the same time, he did not forget his instinct to remind everyone.
A trace of fluctuation flashed across his body, his strength increased exponentially, his speed increased instantly, and he dodged the oncoming steamroller at the critical moment.
"Rumble..."
"Puff puff puff..."
Li Xiaoxiao, who barely escaped, felt a piece of warm liquid pour all over him instantly.
"Ah~!"
Seeing his body turn red and his strength returning to normal, Li Xiaoxiao screamed again, wishing he could faint immediately.
Unfortunately, apart from contributing a large wave of energy, she showed no signs of fainting.
When his hands and feet became weak and he rolled and crawled to the roadside, he couldn't help but vomited.
When she slowly came to her senses and looked up at the middle of the road, she was shocked to find that there was no human figure there. Not even a trace of blood.
Li Xiaoxiao lowered his head, his body was soaked in blood.
"W-what's going on?"
Li Xiaoxiao looked up blankly.
Then…
On the other side of the road, she saw a group of people waiting for a red light.
Moreover, she also saw some people waving to her.
If not the nine people we met earlier, who are they?
Involuntarily, Li Xiaoxiao shuddered, and a wave of fear rose in her heart, making her unable to help but fold her arms across her chest, as if she could get a little warmth and safety in this way.
run…
At this time, Li Xiaoxiao had only this thought in his mind.
In an instant, Li Xiaoxiao turned around and ran away.
"Tap tap tap..."
